conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early glycerin, glycol distearate, shea butter, sodium hyaluronate and two cationic polymer routes form a broad curl/moisture care system despite the strong cleanser.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The formula is silicone-free and strong-cleansing, and the dm same-GTIN delta is preserved rather than merged.
